constraints: No build or write side effects. Requires a current configure-generated build_edges snapshot with matching Ninja and generator-input hashes. Missing, unsupported, ambiguous or stale graphs refuse; no filesystem fallback.

compiler selects the configured compiler edge before Frank; pre_postprocessor selects the active WebFrank/P6 input, which can already contain Frank transformations and is labelled NOT compiler raw. Assembly and overwritten in-place compiler artifacts refuse.

require_exists=False is only for selecting a build target; it does not certify an object exists. Selection never certifies dependency freshness, raw byte exactness, relocation correctness, or semantic equivalence. Build first for fresh measurements.
name: raw_object
purpose: Resolve a TU compiler-stage or pre-WebFrank/P6 object from the active hash-bound build graph, ignoring retired artifacts.
